theorems.name: Submission.w12_ball_smooth_approximation
theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (g : Rn n → Rn n), IsW12WithGradient f g (ball 0 1) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → ∃ φ : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (φ j)) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖φ j x - f x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun j => ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖gradient (φ j) x - g x‖ₑ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
